hook: Ten assets can still be one big bet.
narration: A long list of holdings can hide a common exposure. In this paper companion, rotate a covariance matrix into its principal components. Then compare how much portfolio variance comes from each component. Equal component contributions give three effective bets in our three-mode example. These are synthetic experiments: the result depends on your covariance assumptions. Open The Risk Observatory and change the inputs yourself.

shots.cue: Switch from asset weights to component risk contributions.
Compare concentrated and equal component risk; show effective bets.
Change one mode's volatility and end on the source-linked limitation.
